title: Prague Bus Lines Check

gtfs._why: Today's PID export (valid 29 Sep - 12 Oct 2026); Wednesday 30 Sep is a normal weekday on it.

gtfs_lines_from._why: Owner, 2 Nov 2026: "You're okay for changed lines to move to 2 Nov network, do not move vehicles in lines not affected if possible". These lines come from the 2 Nov export (valid 2-15 Nov), Wednesday 4 Nov; every other line stays on 30 Sep. 131 and 176: gone from 2 Nov 04:00, their trips run as trolleybuses 51 and 53 (PID permanent change "Posílení trolejbusů v Praze"). 112 and 234: new timetables from 2 Nov. 240: the Dubeč - Běchovice diversion of 20 Aug - 2 Nov is over. 149, 158, 166, 167: the 30 Sep export left out Karlštejnská and Butovická, Toužimská, Nemocnice Bulovka and Zahradníčkova; the game lines already stop there. Kept on 30 Sep: 101 (route changed 14 Oct, but cards 100-108 are frozen); 133 (+2 min from the Žižkov tram closure, 11 Oct - 18 Dec); 209 (Druhanická temporarily closed from 1 Nov); 232 (same trips, only the export now calls it a trolleybus).

gone_why.131: its trips run as trolleybus 51 from 2 Nov: delete game line 100131
gone_why.176: its trips run as trolleybus 53 from 2 Nov: delete game line 100176

gtfs_lines_from._195_why: 195 is read from the 2 Nov export so that it and its pooled 158 come from one timetable day; its 224 trips are identical in the 30 Sep and 2 Nov exports, so nothing on 195 changes from this.
gtfs_lines_from._161_why: Owner, 7 Nov 2026 ("yes, please, model these two properly"): 161 and 312 move to the 26 Oct timetables (2 Nov export) and are modelled as they run, although 161 is on a diversion (Bořislavka – Letiště cut back to Přední Kopanina) and 312 on a Tuchoměřice diversion until further notice.

_history_why: user, 29 Sep: designed buses must carry real car numbers from the line history (cars that ran the line since 1 Sep, active, not out anywhere on the vehicle date)

schedule_overrides._why: Hand-set terminus rows (02_gtfs_lines.py applies them, 05_render.py shows them instead of the main-pattern rows) for lines where the shared fit broke the rules: the two ends at different rates, more slots than real departures, or a pair made of two different routes. Each line's _why says what was wrong.
